introText:
EMDC is committed to the development of its people and to a culture of excellence, collaboration and integrity.

To extend our long track record of excellence, EMDC is always looking for dedicated, imaginative and enthusiastic people to join our growing team. In return, we offer you resources and exciting opportunities to develop your career while working with other clever and creative people in shaping the engineering solutions of tomorrow.

careers.title: Project Manager
careers.content:
We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead and coordinate MEP engineering projects from conception to completion. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems, with proven experience in managing complex construction projects.

Responsibilities:

  • Plan, execute, and finalize projects according to strict deadlines and within budget
  • Coordinate with clients, contractors, and internal engineering teams
  • Manage project resources and ensure quality deliverables
  • Monitor project progress and implement corrective actions when necessary
  • Prepare and present project status reports to stakeholders

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related field
  • Minimum 5 years of project management experience in MEP or construction
  • PMP certification preferred
  • Strong leadership and communication skills
  • Proficiency in project management software

careers.title: MEP Engineer
careers.content:
We are looking for a talented MEP Engineer to join our design team. This role involves working on diverse projects including commercial buildings, residential complexes, and industrial facilities.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop MEP systems including HVAC, electrical, and plumbing
  • Prepare detailed engineering drawings and specifications
  • Perform calculations and system analysis
  • Coordinate with architects and other engineering disciplines
  • Review and approve shop drawings
  • Conduct site visits and provide technical support

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or related Engineering field
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in MEP design
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit, and other design software
  • Knowledge of local building codes and standards
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

careers.title: BIM Specialist
careers.content:
Join our innovative BIM team and work on cutting-edge Building Information Modeling projects. We are seeking a BIM Specialist who is passionate about technology and digital construction.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain 3D BIM models using Revit and other BIM software
  • Coordinate MEP systems in integrated BIM models
  • Perform clash detection and resolution
  • Create 4D and 5D BIM models for scheduling and cost estimation
  • Train and support team members on BIM workflows
  • Develop automation tools and scripts to enhance productivity

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, or related field
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in BIM modeling
  • Expert-level proficiency in Autodesk Revit
  • Experience with Navisworks, Dynamo, or Forge API preferred
  • Strong understanding of BIM standards and protocols
  • Programming skills (Python, C#) are a plus

careers.title: Energy & Sustainability Engineer
careers.content:
We are seeking an Energy & Sustainability Engineer to help us deliver green building solutions and renewable energy systems. This role focuses on energy efficiency, sustainability, and environmental responsibility.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct energy audits and assessments
  • Design renewable energy systems including solar PV and solar thermal
  • Perform energy modeling and analysis
  • Develop sustainability strategies for building projects
  • Prepare LEED and other green building certification documentation
  • Evaluate and recommend energy-efficient HVAC and building systems

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or related field
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in energy engineering or sustainability
  • LEED AP certification preferred
  • Proficiency in energy modeling software (eQUEST, EnergyPlus, IES VE)
  • Knowledge of renewable energy technologies
  • Strong commitment to environmental sustainability

careers.title: Electrical Engineer
careers.content:
We are looking for an experienced Electrical Engineer to design power distribution, lighting, and low current systems for various building types.

Responsibilities:

  • Design electrical power distribution systems
  • Develop lighting designs for interior and exterior spaces
  • Design fire alarm, security, and communication systems
  • Prepare electrical drawings and specifications
  • Perform load calculations and system analysis
  • Coordinate with utility companies and authorities

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in building electrical design
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit, and electrical design software
  • Knowledge of local electrical codes (DEWA, SBC, etc.)
  • Experience with lighting design software preferred
